title: I'll play your AI-made CrazyGames game for 10+ minutes. Want to swap real feedback?
author: thecrownforge
selftext:
I have time to test a few games made with AI. Browser games on CrazyGames only, please. Drop your link and tell me one thing you want checked.

I'll play each game I pick for at least 10 minutes. I'll tell you where I got stuck, what felt fun, and whether I wanted to keep playing. I promise to get past the loading screen before writing a review.

I'm making Crownforge, a free kingdom builder. I use LLMs for the code and art. I design the systems, characters and world, then play what comes back and keep changing it. One thing I've learned: AI can make a feature work fast. It can't tell me whether a new player understands it or wants to come back.

My game: [https://www.crazygames.com/game/crownforge](https://www.crazygames.com/game/crownforge)

I'd love a proper first-session test. Please play for at least 10 minutes and make some choices in the game. Tell me what you tried first. Where did you get confused? What made you want to keep playing, or close the tab? If you leave early because something breaks or feels bad, tell me exactly where.

I'd rather get five honest tests like that than fifty quick clicks. If you enjoy the game and feel it deserves a thumbs up on CrazyGames, I'd appreciate it. If not, tell me what to fix. That helps too.

If you share your game, please say how you used AI to make it, and one thing real players surprised you with. If we try each other's games too, we might learn more than we do from testing our own builds for the hundredth time.

I'll go through links one by one, so replies may take a while.
